narrative.overview: An open, clear wayfinding system for bright-light coastal reading. Large narrow lettering establishes place; lines and meaningful data establish rhythm. Descriptive language is inferred from the built delegated brief, not user-interviewed.
keyCharacteristics: Open fields rather than card grids.
Marine and seafoam regions with a sparing signal color.
Functional circular geometry, not ornamental illustration.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Chartreuse identifies the active relationship, never arbitrary decoration.

rules.name: The Open Field Rule
rules.body: Separate subjects with scale, space and tonal fields rather than repeated cards.

dos: Do keep synthetic data labelled beside the data.
Do preserve visible focus and keyboard-operable controls.
Do use the active signal sparingly.
donts: Don't turn open content into repeated cards.
Don't introduce photographs without verified reuse rights.
Don't imply navigation or warning accuracy.
